alex_w: Hey folks — I addressed the review comments from yesterday: added retry guards, a metrics tag, and updated the README. Also added a focused integration test for the router backpressure path. Please take a quick look when you have a sec; would like a Thu morning canary if capacity allows. Smoke steps are below.

morgan: Nice, thanks. Can you paste the smoke steps here so I can run them locally?

alex_w: Sure — quick smoke commands:
```bash
# focused backpressure smoke
./scripts/run-smoke.sh --service router --filter backpressure
# quick smoke for fast check
./scripts/run-smoke.sh --quick
```
I also ran the CI e2e twice locally; it was flaky once but passed on retry.

tay: ran the quick smoke on my laptop, passed. I left two tiny lint nits on the new test file (naming + one unused var). non-blocking.

jen: Quick question — expected perf delta? any p99 impact we should call out?

alex_w: Negligible in my runs — p99 increased ~2ms under our synthetic load (dev GPU). Added a metric tag `router.retry.v2` so we can monitor in the canary.

sam_oncall: I can reserve a canary slot Thu 09:00 UTC. @deploy-ops do you want that slot?

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: Thu Oct 10 09:00:00 UTC — slot ID CNY-3287

tay: LGTM once the lint nits are fixed. nothing blocking.

alex_w: Thanks — pushing a one-line lint fix now and will ping when done. If someone can merge after approvals I'll kick off the canary. PR description includes the smoke script and expected dashboards to watch.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, integration flaky-run x2) — ready to merge when approvals present.

alex_w: Pushed the lint fix. @tay @morgan can one of you merge when free? I'll coordinate canary start and post the watchlist (dashboards + alerts) in the canary thread.
